records.name: Main story
records.summary: Kliff's campaign: a prologue, twelve chapters and an epilogue, played in a fixed order.
records.body: Sources count about 168 main-quest steps across the fourteen sections. The campaign is linear with a single ending; chapters that permanently change the world state list that under their own pointsOfNoReturn as they are confirmed. Chapter titles here are the values quests use in their chapter field.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list
